basic_details.scholarship_name: University of Texas at Austin CS & Engineering Graduate Fellowship (GRA/TA)
basic_details.offering_entity: Department of Computer Science & Cockrell School of Engineering, University of Texas at Austin (Austin, Texas, USA)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: University of Texas at Austin (Bill & Melinda Gates Computer Science Complex, Austin, Texas, USA)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.) in Computer Science across all department research clusters: Machine Learning & Deep Learning, Autonomous Robotics, Systems & Cloud Computing, Computer Vision, Cybersecurity, Quantum Information, Programming Languages, and Theoretical Computer Science.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~100% of all admitted PhD students receive full guaranteed financial packages (~45 to 60 new fully funded PhD students admitted annually)
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open international competition; Pakistani graduates in computer science and engineering compete annually (typically 2 to 5 admitted with full funding/yr)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Full 5 years of guaranteed PhD funding (full tuition waiver, 12-month living stipend, and health insurance) subject to satisfactory academic progress

nationality_requirements: Open to international applicants from all nations worldwide
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed 4-year Bachelor's degree (16 years education) or Master's degree (18 years education) in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Mathematics with minimum 3.75 / 4.00 CGPA (3.85+ competitive from recognized Pakistani universities like LUMS, NUST, FAST-NUCES, GIKI, UET, QAU).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: First-class honors required; GPA 3.85+ recommended for competitive fellowship ranking.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Advanced preparation in algorithms, data structures, computer systems, operating systems, linear algebra, and discrete math.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or currently in final semester of degree graduating before August intake.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Prior research publications, open-source projects, and technical internships significantly enhance the application.

english_proficiency.notes: TOEFL iBT min 79 or IELTS Academic min 6.5 overall. Teaching Assistants must meet Texas English proficiency certification requirements.

eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Elite doctoral researchers in Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: External fellowships can be combined with university top-up awards.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition waiver provided for all 5 years of doctoral study (out-of-state tuition ~$20,000/year waived completely).

admission_application_fee.details: UT Austin Graduate School international application fee ($90) paid by applicant.

accommodation.details: Paid out of living stipend; on-campus university apartments or private housing in Austin (~$800 to $1,200/month).

monthly_stipend.details: Full 12-month living stipend: GRA or TA appointment provides ~$34,000 to $38,000 / year (~$2,800 to $3,150 / month; ~PKR 780,000 to 875,000 / month) as living support.

airfare.details: Travel expenses to Austin, Texas are self-funded.

visa_fee.details: US F-1 Visa application fee ($185) and SEVIS I-901 fee ($350) paid to US Department of State.

health_insurance.details: Academic Graduate Student employee health insurance plan (UT Select) provides comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage (100% premium covered by university; ~$3,600/year value).

food_allowance.details: Meals and personal expenses covered by monthly stipend (~$350 to $450/month).

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Bill & Melinda Gates Complex provides advanced computing infrastructure, GPU clusters, and lab resources.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Departmental professional development travel funds and research grants cover travel and lodging for presenting at top conferences.

travel_transit_allowance.details: CapMetro public transit buses throughout Austin are completely free for all UT Austin students with valid student ID.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single institution (University of Texas at Austin - Top 10 CS in USA, QS World Rank #66)
participating_institutions: University of Texas at Austin (Department of Computer Science, Gates Dell Complex)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: US News #8 in Computer Science globally, Top 5 in Artificial Intelligence; located in Austin, the leading US tech hub ('Silicon Hills').
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's or Master's degree with 3.75+ GPA, strong research accomplishments, Statement of Purpose, 3 reference letters, and English test score.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: 100% of admitted PhD students receive full 5-year funding; admission is highly selective (~5% acceptance rate).
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Research fit is critical. In your Statement of Purpose, identify 2-3 specific UT Austin CS faculty whose published papers directly align with your research trajectory and explain the questions you want to investigate.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: UT Austin Graduate School ApplyTexas / Texas Admissions Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the Texas Admissions portal, select 'Computer Science - PhD', and upload required documents before the December 15 deadline.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Explore research faculty profiles in the UT Austin Department of Computer Science.
Step 2: Create an account on the UT Austin ApplyTexas / Admissions portal.
Step 3: Upload unofficial transcripts from all colleges and universities attended.
Step 4: Upload your Statement of Purpose (highlighting research accomplishments and faculty fit).
Step 5: Provide contact details for 3 academic referees who will submit letters online.
Step 6: Upload your CV and any published research papers or preprints.
Step 7: Submit official TOEFL or IELTS scores (institutional code 6882).
Step 8: Pay the $90 application fee and submit before December 15.
Step 9: Faculty admissions committee conducts comprehensive reviews and interviews in January/February.
Step 10: Receive official offer letter (with 5-year full funding package) in February/March; accept by April 15.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: 100% integrated: admission to the CS PhD program carries the full 5-year fellowship and assistantship package automatically.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Three confidential reference letters submitted online by referees.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of Purpose: Describe your technical background, research goals, why you chose UT Austin CS, and specific faculty you wish to work with.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Integrated into Statement of Purpose; outline research questions, methods, and topics of interest.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Academic CV detailing publications, presentations, software projects, awards, and technical skill proficiencies.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Short technical/research interview (20-30 minutes via Zoom) conducted by interested faculty members prior to formal admission offers.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: GRE General is optional/not required for CS PhD. TOEFL iBT (79+) or IELTS Academic (6.5+).
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Scanned unofficial transcripts uploaded at application; official HEC-attested transcripts and degree certificates required upon enrollment.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translations for all non-English documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% online through UT Austin admissions portal.

required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Ensure name format matches educational documents.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Official Academic Transcripts and Degree Certificate
required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete transcripts of all university degrees showing courses, credits, and grades.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Higher Education Commission (HEC) Pakistan attested documents.

required_documents_checklist.specification: 1 to 2 page essay detailing research background, specific research questions, and faculty alignment.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Mention specific UT Austin CS professors and recent lab publications.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Academic CV detailing publications, presentations, software projects, and awards.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Highlight papers published in Scopus/WoS or IEEE/ACM venues.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Confidential letters from research mentors or senior professors.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Referees should submit from official university email addresses.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official TOEFL iBT (79+) or IELTS Academic (6.5+) report sent to institution code 6882.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Ensure test score is valid at commencement.

important_dates_timeline.application_deadline: 15 December (Strict PhD deadline for Fall admission)
important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: One annual intake cycle closing on 15 December for admission in the subsequent Fall semester.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 35% (Undergraduate/Master's GPA and performance in core CS/math coursework)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 35% (Track record of independent research, publications, and technical innovation)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Clarity, depth, and originality of Statement of Purpose)
selection_process_and_weights.recommendations_weight: 10% (Strong, credible endorsements from established research mentors)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: Decisive during advisor review for candidate ranking
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: UT Austin CS Graduate Admissions Committee and individual faculty lab PIs.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Holistic, research-oriented evaluation. The committee selects candidates demonstrating both high intellectual rigor and genuine research creativity. Admitted PhD students receive guaranteed 5-year funding through departmental fellowships, GRAs, or TAs.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~2,500 to 3,000 elite international applicants compete for UT Austin CS PhD seats
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~45 to 60 fully funded PhD offers made annually
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~3% to 4% (Achievable for top graduates from LUMS, NUST, FAST with published research)
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: 3.85+ / 4.00 CGPA (85%+ aggregate) with at least 1 published conference paper or preprint
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates of leading institutions with substantial research contributions in machine learning, systems, or vision, and strong recommendation letters.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, and Applied Mathematics.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: USA, China, India, Pakistan, South Korea, Iran, Taiwan.

fake_websites_and_scams: Scam agencies claiming they can guarantee admission to UT Austin CS. Admissions decisions are made solely by UT Austin faculty committees.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: UT Austin application fee is $90. Never pay external agencies.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Do not hire agents. Writing your own Statement of Purpose is essential for conveying your research vision.
hidden_costs_breakdown: US F-1 Visa fee ($185) and SEVIS fee ($350).
Flight tickets between Pakistan and Austin-Bergstrom International Airport (AUS, ~PKR 250,000 - 350,000).
Initial apartment security deposit (~$800 - $1,200) prior to first stipend deposit.
misleading_claims_debunked: CLAIM: GRE scores are required. (FACT: UT Austin CS does NOT require GRE scores).
CLAIM: You must secure funding separately after admission. (FACT: All admitted PhD students receive a 5-year full funding guarantee automatically).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Third-party sites frequently quote outdated stipend rates; current UT Austin CS GRA/TA stipends range from $34,000 to $38,000/year.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.00 / 4.00 in all graduate coursework to remain in good standing.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical research and teaching residency on the Austin campus.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual progress reviews evaluated by the dissertation committee.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Under US F-1 visa regulations, paid employment is restricted to 20 hours/week on campus during semesters.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None. F-1 STEM graduates are eligible for 36 months of Optional Practical Training (OPT) in the United States post-graduation.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: None; scholars fulfill standard graduate research or teaching assistantship duties (20 hours/week).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Funding terminates upon withdrawal; no clawback of past disbursed stipend or tuition.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Requires approval from the Graduate Committee.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Funding is guaranteed for 5 years; extensions beyond Year 5 are supported through faculty research grants.
